{{Quote|Me? Force-sensitive? That's pretty hard to believe. I guess I'd better check it out, though.|Talia Reede|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Talia Reede''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[entertainer]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a female [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Second Lieutenant/Legends|Second Lieutenant]], named [[Aaph Koden]], became involved in a series of operations to save Reede from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. With the help of a Rebel agent, Reede was rescued from the Empire and brought to [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] to begin her [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi training/Legends|training]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|She's so skeptical -- it took a while to convince her she might be Force-sensitive. Can you believe it? Anyone else in the galaxy would give his right arm to be trained as a Jedi, but her we have to talk in to it.|Aaph Koden|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a female [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Second Lieutenant/Legends|Second Lieutenant]] named [[Aaph Koden]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], learned that [[entertainer]] Talia Reede might be a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. Knowing the dangers of being a Force-sensitive in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial-controlled]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], Koden hoped to deliver a warning message to Reede.<ref name="SWG" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Fortunately, Koden encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who happened to be a loyal member of the Rebellion. Koden asked the Rebel agent to deliver the warning to Reede, with the hope that she would recognize the danger, and contact the Alliance for help. The Rebel agent agreed, and set off to find Talia Reede. When Reede received the message, she expressed surprise at being a Force-sensitive. However, she told the Rebel that she would check it out.<ref name="SWG" />

However the situation grew worse. The Empire had learned of Talia Reede's Force-sensitivity, and were on their way to kill her. Aaph Koden, unable to entrust anyone else with the mission, asked the same Rebel agent to save Reede. When the Rebel asked why Reede could not simply use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to save herself, Koden replied that Reede was not adequately trained. Ultimately, the Rebel agreed to save Reede from an Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and two other stormtroopers. Fortunately for Reede and the Rebel agent, the stormtroopers proved no match. Koden eventually asked the Rebel to help Reede again, this time by escorting her safely to [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi training/Legends|training]]. When the Rebel asked why Reede had not started training sooner, Koden answered that Reede was still skeptical she was a Force-sensitive. Koden believed that she simply needed to be convinced. Once again, the Rebel agent agreed to help, and successfully found Reede and brought her back safely to [[City/Legends|town]]. Though she still found the whole idea of Jedi training farfetched, she agreed to give it a try. From then on, Talia Reede would begin her training under the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You should be very proud. You may have saved the life of a future Jedi Knight.|Aaph Koden|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Reede had tan [[Color/Legends|colored]] skin, brown eyebrows, and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. She was also an entertainer. Before being contacted by the Rebel agent, Reede was totally oblivious to the fact that she was Force-sensitive. Before the Rebel approached her, she noticed a [[rock]] fly past her, but dismissed this as a mirage, rather than an unintentional use of the Force. Even after nearly being hunted down by stormtroopers, Reede commented to the Rebel agent that the whole idea of Jedi training still seemed farfetched to her. Indeed, Reede was quite unaware of her abilities, but Aaph Koden felt she simply needed to be convinced. Indeed, Koden was confident that Reede had the markings of a future [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|She hasn't been trained to use the Force, she just has the potential.|Aaph Koden|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Because Reede had never been formally trained in the Force, she could not use any [[Force power/Legends|powers]] to her advantage. However, she did once notice a rock fly past her. She dismissed this as a mirage, rather than an unintentional use of [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]]. Before being brought to Anchorhead to begin her Jedi training, Reede was for the most part helpless, depending on the Rebel agent to escort her safely to Koden. Nonetheless, Koden felt that Reede could one day become a Jedi Knight.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateEntertainer.png|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Talia Reede, including one male depiction deemed non-canon in Legends]]
Talia Reede was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Players who performed a series of [[:w:c:swg:Quest|quests]] for Koden had to deliver a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] to Talia Reede, rescue her from [[:w:c:swg:Imperial Stormtrooper|stormtroopers]], and escort her safely back to [[:w:c:swg:Anchirhead|Anchorhead]]. Although the player could choose not to do Koden's quests, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="SWG" />

Although not mentioned in the quest dialogue, examining Reede revealed her to be an [[:w:c:swg:Entertainer|entertainer]].<ref name="SWG" />
